correctness.rationale: PASS: Direct Legendre-integral evaluation gives A0=(1+e^{-pi a})/(1+a²), A1=(1-e^{-pi a})/(4+a²) and positive two-step recurrence A_{n+2}/A_n=(a²+n²)/(a²+(n+3)²). Using xP_n recurrence, C_n= A_{n-1}(a²+n²+n+1)/(a²+(n+2)²) for n>=1 and C0=A1>0, so Schoenberg signs of A_n+bC_n reduce exactly to b>=-inf_n A_n/C_n. The explicit ratio T_{n+2}/T_n numerator-minus-denominator is 3(2n+3)(3n²+9n-7-7a²); therefore each parity has a single valley with possible tie and only the claimed two candidate degrees need checking, while T2<A0/A1. Boundary zeros occur in finitely many degrees, leaving infinitely many positive Legendre coefficients of each parity; Chen-Menegatto-Sun strictness gives strict positive definiteness. Independently simplified polynomial identity symbolically; numerically quadrature-checked Legendre coefficients for a=.2,1,2,5,10, degrees 0..5 and verified two-candidate minima through 29 degrees. Finite calculations support but do not substitute for the analytic all-degree proof.
